speaker: MARK
text: Oh, come on. You've been sitting on that all night?

speaker: JASON
text: Thought you said I was easy to read.

speaker: MARK
text: You are. When I'm sober.

speaker: MARK
text: All right... you won. I'll send the coordinates.

speaker: MARK
text: Jason. Look at me. Don't go there. I'm serious.

speaker: JASON
text: What happened out there?

speaker: MARK
text: I don't want to talk about it. Not tonight.

speaker: MARK
text: I think I'm done, Jason. I just... don't have it in me anymore. I used to love this work.

speaker: JASON
text: I'm tired of scraping by. One good haul, and Stacy and I might actually get somewhere.

speaker: MARK
text: Yeah... I used to tell myself that too.

speaker: MARK
text: Wait... you're going anyway, aren't you? I know you.

speaker: MARK
text: My pack's still out there. Little shelter, east of the yard road. Broken amber marker by the drain.

speaker: JASON
text: You left your gear?

speaker: MARK
text: There's a computer in there. Looks like junk. It isn't. I'll send you the software.

speaker: MARK
text: Take it. I'm not going back. But listen... if it feels wrong, you leave. Right away.

speaker: JASON
text: Hey, Stace, it's me. I'm heading out. Might be out of range for a while. I'll call you when I can.

speaker: ORAC
text: Well, Mark wasn't making it up. Still, no one's answering us.

speaker: JASON
text: He didn't mention it was this big.

speaker: ORAC
text: I've found a way in. Give me a moment to match its rotation.

speaker: JASON
text: All right. Let's have a look.
